messages:
Rae (CEO): Quick post-all-hands Q&A: want one clear list of next steps on the pipeline, partner pilot, and co-sell ops. Keep replies short.
Tara - VP Sales: Pipeline healthy (~3x coverage). Two top deals in legal. Question: pilot pricing and discount guardrails?
Maya (Finance): Recommend pilot pricing: 15% off list, time-limited. AE discount cap at 15%; >15% needs RevOps+Sales exec sign-off.
Liam (Partnerships): Pilot partner requests SAML SSO + webhook for user sync, plus co-branded collateral with a 5-business-day review SLA.
Ana (PM): Eng estimate for SAML + webhook spike: 2 devs x 8 working days + 1 QA x 3 days. Will tag ticket `partner-pilot-q1`.
Rhea (RevOps): RevOps will own partner attribution rules. Request partners add `partner_id` param to signup links. I'll create a reporting view.
Tara - VP Sales: We'll draft a short co-sell playbook (crediting, discounts, lead handoff) and publish in Sales Drive.
ops-bot: Calendar: "Partner Pilot Kickoff" created Fri 9:30 AM PT (invites sent).
Rae (CEO): Recap actions: 1) Eng spike for SAML/webhook (Ana). 2) RevOps to finalize attribution + commission flow (Rhea). 3) Finance to document pilot pricing & clawback (Maya). 4) Partnerships + Sales to publish playbook (Liam + Tara). Follow-up in kickoff invite.
Tara - VP Sales: If anyone has a resource conflict, DM me and Rae.
Ana (PM): Spike ticket created and linked in the invite.
Maya (Finance): I'll send the pilot billing note by EOD.
Liam (Partnerships): I'll post the 1-pager to #partnerships by Thursday.
Rae (CEO): Thanks all. Closing thread — add any remaining items to the kickoff invite or shared doc.
